title: Optimize index row id set merging
constraints: Preserve index scan exactness and row id semantics
rationale: try_index_scan merged row id sets with intersection/union plus cloned collect, allocating new sets and cloning row ids. FTS token intersection also used the same pattern.
steps: Reuse existing HashSet storage for FTS token intersections
Reuse the smaller existing HashSet for AND intersections
Extend an existing HashSet for OR unions
Mark FTS token-index plans exact so key-only projection does not re-evaluate MATCH on partial rows
Add a focused FTS multi-token regression
expected_impact: Reduces row id cloning and temporary HashSet allocation in index scan planning and fixes FTS index exactness for key-only projections.
